Every setting with p99 above 200 ms was refused, never traded for throughput. Best of the rest is 700.0 req/s.
Next best: batch 5, workers 11, prefetch 0 gives 687.5 req/s at p99 200.0 ms (on the limit, no margin).
Note: the bench model has no worker cap or CPU cost. Check that 14 workers fit the real host before deploying.
